verdict.rationale: Docs confirm full-text, fuzzy search that works offline on all devices with fast results (capacities-docs-10, 22, 42, 37/13), and the object-type/property/tag system exists for organizing content, but no documentation explicitly describes search filters scoped to tags, properties, or paths.
